LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: Represents an SDK license key generated for client authentication.

key.description: The unique license key used by the SDK.

status.description: The current status of the key.

expiryType.description: Whether the key lasts forever or expires after registration + duration.

durationDays.description: Number of days the key is valid after first activation.

activatedAt.description: The ISO timestamp when the key was first used.

deviceLimit.description: Maximum number of devices allowed. 0 means unlimited.

devices.description: Map of registered hardware IDs (HWIDs) to registration timestamps.

sdkType.description: The specific SDK variant (e.g. Standard, Premium, Bypass).

allowedPackage.description: Optional packageName restriction (e.g., com.example.app). Empty means any package.

creatorEmail.description: The email of the administrator who created the key.

createdAt.description: The ISO timestamp when the key was created.

updatedAt.description: The ISO timestamp when the key was last updated.

ValidationLog.title: ValidationLog
ValidationLog.description: Logs recording SDK validation inquiries from .aar files.

key.description: The license key supplied during verification.

hwid.description: Hardware ID sent by the Android .aar client.

packageName.description: The package name of the app containing the .aar client.

ip.description: IP address of the device making the request.

sdkType.description: The SDK type linked to the license key.

timestamp.description: Date-time when the transaction took place.

keys/{keyId}.description: Collection of all licenses and keys.

logs/{logId}.description: Validation event logs for client-SDK monitoring.
